scalars.scalar_value: Experience contributing to and cultivating inclusive acuity and leadership governance structures.

Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in leading programs and initiatives related to inclusive excellence at a medical education, other higher education, or an education-focused professional environment.

items.item_text: Masters Degree
PhD or EdD preferred.

Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in leading programs and initiatives related to inclusive excellence at a medical education, other higher education, or an education-focused professional environment.
Experience contributing to and cultivating inclusive acuity and leadership governance structures.
Minimum of three (3) years in a leadership role with or without direct reports.
Successful experience in a leadership position directly relevant to inclusive excellence.
Experience identifying best practices of inclusive excellence and facilitating their adoption and implementation at an educational institution.
Experience in assuring compliance with relevant laws and policies that are relevant to inclusive excellence in an educational setting (e.g., Title IX).
Experience and knowledge in research and practice in the fields of inclusivity and equity in education.
Provides operational oversight for designated functional areas within the office, ensuring efficient workflows and alignment with departmental goals and priorities.
Provide oversight over the design and implementation of programs and events that promote awareness, education and engagement around inclusive excellence.
Partners with internal and external partners on strategic initiatives, coordinate activities, and foster collaborative relationships that support organizational objectives.
Collaborate with Senior Associate Dean for Admissions; Senior Associate Dean for Inclusive Excellence to align on outreach, recruitment and pathway strategies with KPSOMs mission and strategic goals.
Establish metrics to measure impact, inform decision making and evaluate the success of programs.
Use data-driven insights to guide continuous program improvement and innovation.
Oversee the development and delivery of inclusive resources that inspire and prepare students across educational pathways to pursue careers in medicine.
Oversee workshops, mentorship opportunities, and other initiatives that expand access and align with institutional priorities.
Oversee the design and implementation of comprehensive health professions pathway programs that provide academic support, mentorship, and career guidance for aspiring medical students.
In consultation with the Senior Associate Dean for Admissions; Senior Associate Dean for Inclusive Excellence, establish a system of monitoring, assessing, and evaluating pathways programs and goals.
Identify funding opportunities and write grant proposals to sustain and expand programming.
Collaborate with the Office of Student Affairs to provide pathways engagement opportunities for KPSOM medical students.
Serve on relevant KPSOM committees and perform other administrative tasks as needed.
Supervise and develop Office of Inclusive Excellence through hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, training, resource planning, accountability, and succession planning.

Partner with KPSOM team members to ensure compliance with Western Association of Schools and Colleges (WASC), Senior College and University Commission (WSCUC) and Liaison Committee for Medical Education (LCME) accreditation standards related to inclusive excellence.
Ability to adapt to a changing environment, lead and manage a wide variety of initiatives, and collaborate across organizational departments and functions.
Knowledge of WASC and LCME Principles of Accreditation.
Ability to influence others and drive results across teams in a complex organization
